stopped_by.bank_change: RED: bank details differ from the account you paid before
stopped_by.fake_invoice_or_thread: AMBER/RED: the attacker's account is one you have never paid (or differs from the real supplier's)
stopped_by.ceo_wire: AMBER: first payment to a new account
stopped_by.payroll: out of scope for supplier invoices; same rule applies to an employee's changed salary account (HR mode)
stopped_by.gift_or_p2p: out of scope: gift cards / Venmo, not an invoice payment
stopped_by.recon: no payment requested yet; caught later when bank details are sent

caught_at_payment_by_history_check: 34/34 (by construction: the payee account is changed or new)
